claims_submitted_check.name: claims_submitted_check
claims_submitted_check.value: "claims"."status" = 'draft' or ("claims"."incident_at" is not null and "claims"."incident_location" is not null and "claims"."description" is not null and "claims"."declaration_accepted_at" is not null and "claims"."submitted_at" is not null)

quotes_accepted_check.name: quotes_accepted_check
quotes_accepted_check.value: "quotes"."status" <> 'accepted' or ("quotes"."payment_plan" is not null and "quotes"."details_confirmed_at" is not null and "quotes"."cover_acknowledged_at" is not null)

underwriting_decisions_loading_percent_c.name: underwriting_decisions_loading_percent_check
underwriting_decisions_loading_percent_c.value: "underwriting_decisions"."loading_percent" is null or ("underwriting_decisions"."outcome" = 'quoted' and "underwriting_decisions"."loading_percent" between 0 and 100)
